entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to make a return. I bought a jersey and it's just not right. I'm so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I think I ordered the wrong size. It's just way too tight, and I feel awful about it. I saved up for this, you know? I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and this was supposed to be a treat for myself.
I completely understand wanting to get the perfect fit, especially with our performance gear. Let's see what we can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I really hope this can be sorted out. I just need the money back if it's not going to work.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey, delivered 23 days ago. That's no problem at all.

Not at all. For our standard apparel items like this jersey, VeloFit has a 90-day return policy. You are well within that window. We can either process a full refund or, if you'd like, I can help you set up an exchange for a different size right now.
Oh, wow! Really? A full refund or an exchange? That's... that's amazing. I was so worried. An exchange would be perfect, actually. I'd love to try one size up.

Excellent! I'm happy we could find a solution for you. I've just initiated the exchange in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just send the jersey that's too tight back to us, and we'll ship out the new size as soon as we receive it.
David, thank you so much! You've completely turned my day around. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
